Connectors._about: Loopback only: Urls must be localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] or the host refuses to start; the internet reaches /hooks through the POSitive Anywhere server's forward (Positive:Connectors:HostUrl there). Empty paths = %ProgramData%\POSitiveAnywhereV2\connectors.json, ...\connectors\connectors.db, ...\connectors\secrets.json and ...\connectors\forward.token.
Connectors._aboutPosApiBaseUrl: Where the connector calls POSitive Anywhere with its API key. Must be this machine (localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]) or the host refuses to start.
Connectors._aboutAllowPrivateStoreHosts: Dev only. false (default) = store addresses on loopback, link-local or private networks are refused (SSRF guard). true lets a dev store on localhost:8090 / host.docker.internal / the LAN be connected.
